candidates.name: ShaSpec
candidates.mechanism: shared/specific features + alignment/domain auxiliary tasks + unavailable-feature generation/residual fusion

blockers: classification implementation not found in pinned repo
symmetric CFP/OCT missing training requires protocol
candidates.training_pairing: Primary paper studies missing-modality classification and segmentation under dedicated/non-dedicated missing settings. The pinned public repository exposes BraTS 3D segmentation code; the paper classification implementation/recipe is not present there, so a symmetric CFP-missing/OCT-missing training schedule is NOT yet author-code-locked.
candidates.inference_inputs: Scientific role is prediction from available modalities with unavailable-modality information reconstructed/generated in feature space. For the eye adapter, inference must use only the actually available CFP/OCT branch plus ShaSpec missing-feature mechanism; absent modality and target label remain forbidden.
candidates.fair_A_vs_A_LOOK: Train one paper-faithful adapted ShaSpec A once; freeze that exact checkpoint and all missing-input rules. BraTS 3D segmentation weights as an eye classifier
candidates.alternative_explanation_removed: Same frozen ShaSpec A separates incremental LOOK correction from gains caused by retraining/replacing the missing-modality method.
scientific_decisions: paper-faithful 2D classification architecture because author classification code is absent from pinned repo
legal LOOK node and complete-input reference semantics

candidates.name: U-HVED
candidates.mechanism: variational shared latent from observed subsets; modality completion + segmentation
candidates.training_pairing: Author implementation is TensorFlow 1.12/NiftyNet for 3D BraTS. It builds a hetero-modal variational latent from observed modality subsets, jointly reconstructs modalities and segments tumour; subset handling is intrinsic to the model/inference.
candidates.inference_inputs: One or more available MRI modalities; latent fusion supports subsets and decoder produces completion/segmentation. Eye use would need a new 2D two-modality classification head/decoder contract.
candidates.fair_A_vs_A_LOOK: Adapt and train one 2D U-HVED A with its variational/completion objective preserved; freeze it. A+LOOK must use that same A and legal latent/classifier representation, with no A retraining.
reusable_assets: LOOK fit/replay after legal nodes exist
not_reusable: legacy TensorFlow graph as a direct LOOK host
candidates.alternative_explanation_removed: Represents an explicit generative/completion family, testing LOOK after missing information is modelled rather than after a plain fusion host.
scientific_decisions: whether image reconstruction is scientifically necessary or latent completion is sufficient
candidates.author_recipe_limitations: 3D segmentation/completion in a legacy TensorFlow/NiftyNet stack; no author eye-classification recipe.

candidates.name: RFNet
candidates.mechanism: region-aware available-modality fusion + per-modality segmentation regularization
blockers: region/segmentation semantics do not map directly to eye classification
candidates.training_pairing: Author code trains a 3D BraTS segmentation network with modality masks, fused loss plus per-modality/region-aware regularization; README evaluates complete/incomplete modality combinations (15 subset states).
candidates.inference_inputs: Available modality subset with feature mask; output is segmentation. A 2D eye-classification adaptation would need a new task head and a principled replacement for region/segmentation auxiliary semantics.
candidates.fair_A_vs_A_LOOK: Train one faithful adapted RFNet A once and freeze it; compare same A vs A+LOOK. Region-aware/per-modality regularizers cannot be deleted merely to simplify LOOK insertion.
reusable_assets: LOOK fit/replay after legal fused representation is defined
not_reusable: segmentation-region heads as a binary classifier
candidates.alternative_explanation_removed: Tests LOOK after explicit available-modality robust fusion, but only if the classification adapter preserves what makes RFNet RFNet.
scientific_decisions: meaning of region-aware mechanism for image-level grading
classification analogue of per-modality auxiliary regularization
candidates.author_recipe_limitations: Author task is 3D tumour segmentation, not image-level classification; no explicit repository license file found.

candidates.name: mmFormer
candidates.mechanism: modality-specific encoders + intra/inter-modal transformers + explicit mask + auxiliary regularizers
candidates.training_pairing: Author code is 3D BraTS incomplete segmentation with explicit modality masks, modality-specific encoders/intra-modal Transformers, inter-modal Transformer, fused and auxiliary losses.
candidates.inference_inputs: 3D multimodal tensor plus availability mask; can evaluate modality subsets. Eye adaptation needs two 2D image streams and a classification head.
candidates.fair_A_vs_A_LOOK: Train one fixed 2D classification mmFormer A once; freeze checkpoint/masks. A+LOOK reads/writes legal modality-specific/fused representations without retraining A or removing auxiliary regularizers.
reusable_assets: Apache-2.0 implementation concepts/code subject to adapter review
not_reusable: 3D BraTS pretrained weights as eye classifier
candidates.alternative_explanation_removed: Would test an explicit mask-aware robust-fusion family, but the new Transformer host/capacity remains a large cross-method confound.
candidates.author_recipe_limitations: Author task is 3D segmentation; adapting to 2D binary grading substantially changes task/head/capacity.

candidates.name: Missing-Aware Prompts
candidates.mechanism: missing-type-aware prompts in ViLT; explicit missing ratio/type
candidates.training_pairing: Pinned author config explicitly defines missing_ratio train/val/test=0.7, missing_type=both, both_ratio=0.5; base ViLT can be fixed, prompt_length=16 and prompt_layers=0..5. Downstream configs include visual-recognition classification tasks.
candidates.inference_inputs: Image/text inputs with explicit missing-type handling/prompts. Current CFP/OCT are two image modalities, so directly reusing image-text semantics/pretraining is not a faithful adapter.
candidates.fair_A_vs_A_LOOK: Only after a two-image missing-aware-prompt A is scientifically defined: train prompt/adapted A once, freeze it, then compare same A vs A+LOOK without changing missing prompts/backbone.
reusable_assets: LOOK fit/replay once legal transformer node exists
not_reusable: ViLT image-text pretrained semantics as an automatically matched CFP/OCT host
candidates.alternative_explanation_removed: Represents a parameter-efficient missing-aware adaptation family, but image-text→image-image redesign is itself a major alternative explanation.
candidates.author_recipe_limitations: Classification is relevant but modality types are image/text rather than two medical images; no explicit repository license file found.
